note: Hand-maintained figures the hospital view and the patient share use that no pinned CMS data file carries. Each names where it was read. The derived tables carry these values; nothing else may retype them. Refresh the deductibles each November; each figure must be in a quote and each quote on the downloaded fact sheet (sources.json, the entry with the same URL), checked by the crosswalk build and tests/test_raw.py.

deductibles.source: CMS fact sheet, 2027 Medicare Parts A & B Premiums and Deductibles, 2026-11-17 (notices CMS-8092-N, CMS-8093-N, CMS-8094-N)
quotes: The Medicare Part A inpatient hospital deductible that beneficiaries pay if admitted to the hospital will be $1,776 in 2027, an increase of $40 from $1,736 in 2026.
The annual deductible for all Medicare Part B beneficiaries will be $292 in 2027, an increase of $9 from the annual deductible of $283 in 2026.
